question: Why do villages in Emilia serve free pasta every 25 July?
answer: To repeat the Cervi family's feast. On 25 July 1943, when Mussolini fell, the Cervi farmers of Campegine cooked vats of pasta for their whole village. That December the seven Cervi brothers, active in the Resistance, were shot by Fascists. The pastasciutta antifascista returns each summer: a plate of noodles as a political act.
move: A shared meal can carry a memory longer than any monument.
source: Alcide Cervi, I miei sette figli, 1955
reference: Alcide Cervi, I miei sette figli, ed. Renato Nicolai, 1955
